## ⚠️ Important Upgrade Notes

- Helm chart: if you set some `probes` keys, the keys you did not set now take the new defaults (10 s period, 5 s timeout). If you tuned `failureThreshold` for the old 60 s period, also set `periodSeconds: 60`. Probe values that are not positive integers now fail `helm install` and `helm upgrade`. Quoted numbers such as `"5"` still work. ([#42571](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42571))
- `navigateTo` to a page name that no longer exists now fails with "Enter a valid URL or page name", even when a parameter value contains a dot. Before, it opened the name as a web address, such as `https://OldPage?file=report.pdf`. A one-word host such as `intranet` with a dotted parameter now fails too. Use a full URL instead. ([#42513](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42513))

## 🔐 Security

- Updated bundled dependencies to address a reported vulnerability. ([#42502](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42502))
- Reading an app's custom JS libraries now requires read access to that app. ([#42431](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42431))
- Turning on **Make application forkable** now requires export permission on the app. Users with edit access can still turn it off and make other changes. ([#42411](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42411))
- S3-compatible and DynamoDB datasources now follow the restricted host policy that already covers REST, GraphQL, Elasticsearch, Redis and SMTP. A datasource whose endpoint host is blocked fails to save, test or run with `Host not allowed.` ([#42527](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42527))

## 🛠️ Reliability

- Deleting a Git-connected app returns as soon as the app is removed. Local repository cleanup runs afterwards, so a slow disk no longer makes the delete time out and leave the app card in place. ([#42519](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42519))
- MCP `read_pages` returns a `layoutId` for every page. Parallel page reads are no longer refused by the token check, a failed read is retried once, and a page that still fails reports why. ([#42360](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42360), [#42529](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42529))
- MCP refuses inputs that used to give broken or wrong results. Examples: unbalanced braces in `wire_event` call arguments, a page from another app in layout tools, and a structured SQL filter on a column named like a SQL keyword. ([#42536](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42536), [#42537](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42537))
- MCP layout updates are refused when the page changed after the agent read it. ([#42538](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42538))

## ✨ New Features & Enhancements

- **Table auto height:** set the Table's **Height** to **Auto Height** (or **Auto Height with limits**) and choose **Rows per page**. The table grows to fit those rows and the page scrolls instead of the table. Existing tables stay **Fixed**. ([#42489](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42489), [#42585](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42585))
- App Settings → Navigation has **Show share** and **Show all apps** toggles to hide those buttons in the published app. Both are on by default. Sharing permissions do not change. ([#42487](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42487))
- Page export (page menu → **Export**) has **Select All** in every section: JS objects, Databases, Queries and Custom libraries. ([#42453](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42453))
- Button Group buttons can show a tooltip, as the Button widget does. ([#42583](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42583))
- JSON Form has a **Title font color** setting under Style → Color. ([#42565](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42565))
- MCP structured SQL can show a fallback value for a NULL column with `coalesce`. ([#42497](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42497))
- MCP structured SQL can filter aggregated groups with `having`. ([#42503](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42503))
- MCP structured SQL can split a delimited column and count each item, on PostgreSQL. ([#42504](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42504))
- MCP `get_action` returns the SQL of a query that MCP wrote, as long as nobody changed it in the editor. ([#42505](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42505))
- New MCP tool `set_page_visibility` hides or shows a page. The home page cannot be hidden. ([#42506](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42506))
- MCP navigate events can pass URL parameters, such as the id of the selected row. ([#42507](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42507))
- Removing widgets through MCP now needs the user's approval (`prepare_remove_widgets`, `confirm_remove_widgets`), as deleting a page or query already does. ([#42509](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42509))
- MCP JS objects can sort, cut, sum, average and group rows, and bucket dates by day, week or month. ([#42511](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42511))
- MCP can build conditional forms: defaults and limits that depend on a choice, date math, fields shown or required in one case, a submit button disabled until the form is valid, and the signed-in user's name or email. ([#42540](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42540))
- MCP can read JS objects written in the editor. Where approval is set up, it can replace them after the user approves. ([#42538](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42538))
- MCP writes JS objects as readable, formatted code. ([#42549](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42549))
- MCP structured queries produce a runnable body on Oracle and use strict values in MongoDB queries. ([#42538](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42538))

## 🎨 UI & Widget Improvements

- Table CSV and Excel downloads write plain text for HTML columns, not raw HTML. ([#42557](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42557))
- Icon Button, Menu Button and Video controls in Table cells fit the row height, so paginated tables no longer need a scrollbar to reach the last row. ([#42570](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42570))
- Turning off infinite scroll in a Table no longer turns on **Allow adding a row**, search, filters and sort. They stay off until you turn them on. ([#42573](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42573))
- The Table Save/Discard column **Disabled** field shows its full binding again. Editing it no longer enables Save/Discard on every row. ([#42589](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42589))
- Resetting a JSON Form keeps an empty Array field empty, so the form stays valid. ([#42226](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42226))
- A required date field in JSON Form shows its error only after the user touches it, like other fields. ([#42514](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42514))
- The workspace logo picker no longer offers SVG, which the server always rejected. JPG files can now be picked. ([#42594](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42594))
- The editor hides the retired Appsmith AI datasource and its queries. The service stopped on September 30, 2026. Ask AI is not affected. ([#42559](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42559))

## 🔧 Git, Deployment & Configuration

- Helm chart health probes now run every 10 s with a 5 s timeout. Startup allows 600 s to boot, liveness restarts the container after 180 s of failure, and readiness marks the pod unready after 30 s. Saving admin settings that restart the server no longer gets the container killed. ([#42571](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42571))
- Backups can skip MongoDB collections listed in `APPSMITH_BACKUP_EXCLUDE_COLLECTIONS` (comma-separated). ([#42581](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42581))
- The server logs why it refuses an MCP token, such as an expired or revoked key. It never logs the secret. ([#42593](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42593))
use_case: Internal tools, admin panels and database frontends
